plugin.name: MixcloudDirect
plugin.title: Mixcloud Direct
plugin.desc: Mixcloud for Lyrion servers that can't run the official plugin (built for 9.0 servers that can't upgrade; tested on 8.5, 9.0, 9.1 and 9.2). No login, no yt-dlp. Read-only: browse, search and play; manage your account on mixcloud.com.
plugin.creator: Ethan Rosch
